# epilayer_load_balancer (Resource)

Load Balancer resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "epilayer_images" "cloud_images" {
  filter = {
    type = "cloud-image"
  }
}

locals {
  # Find the image ID for ubuntu-24.04, or fallback to the first available image if not found
  image_id = try(
    [for img in data.epilayer_images.cloud_images.images : img.id if img.slug == "ubuntu-24.04"][0],
    data.epilayer_images.cloud_images.images[0].id
  )
}

resource "epilayer_instance" "example" {
  name   = "example-instance"
  region = "NORD-NO-KRS-1"

  image = local.image_id
  type  = "vcpu-2_memory-4g"

  private_network_ids = [
    "net-31e8c8f1-bca6-4ff9-af06-0f1d3624d158"
  ]

  ssh_key_ids = [
    "sk-b87aad9c-5ff8-4cd4-bd49-d50e9560194f"
  ]
}

resource "epilayer_load_balancer" "example" {
  name        = "my-load-balancer-1"
  region      = "NORD-NO-KRS-1"
  network     = "net-31e8c8f1-bca6-4ff9-af06-0f1d3624d158"
  mode        = "tcp"
  description = "This is a an example load balancer"

  ports = [
    {
      port        = 80
      target_port = 8080
      targets     = [epilayer_instance.example.private_ip]
    },
    {
      port        = 443
      target_port = 8443
      targets     = [epilayer_instance.example.private_ip]
    }
  ]

  health_check = {
    protocol = "http"
    port     = 8080
    path     = "/"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) The load balancer mode. Supported modes: `tcp`.
  - If the value of this attribute changes, the resource will be replaced.
  - The value must be one of: ["tcp"].
- `name` (String) The human-readable name for the load balancer.
- `network` (String) The private network to use for the load balancer.
  - If the value of this attribute changes, the resource will be replaced.
- `ports` (Attributes List) List of port mappings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ports))
- `region` (String) The region identifier. Currently, only `NORD-NO-KRS-1` is supported.
  - If the value of this attribute changes, the resource will be replaced.
  - The value must be one of: ["NORD-NO-KRS-1"].

### Optional

- `description` (String) The human-readable description for the load balancer.
  - Sets the default value "" if the attribute is not set.
- `floating_ip_id` (String) The ID of an existing floating IP to use as the external IP of the load balancer.
- `health_check` (Attributes) Health check configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the load balancer was created.
- `external_ip` (String) The external IP of the load balancer.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the load balancer.
- `status` (String) The load balancer status.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the load balancer was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ports`

Required:

- `port` (Number) The port exposed on the load balancer.
  - The value must be between 1 and 65535.
- `target_port` (Number) The port to forward traffic to on the targets.
  - The value must be between 1 and 65535.
- `targets` (List of String) List of target IP addresses.


<a id="nestedatt--health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check`

Required:

- `port` (Number) The port to use for the health check.
  - The value must be between 1 and 65535.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol to use for the health check. Supported protocols: `http`, `https`, `tcp`.
  - The value must be one of: ["http" "https" "tcp"].

Optional:

- `path` (String) The path to use for http/https health checks.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import epilayer_load_balancer.example lb-e0c098da-7078-454f-8951-a82f6ad2f599
```
